sources.title: GitHub - ciphermosaic/phi3.5-mini-openassistant
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Microsoft's Phi-3.5 Mini Instruct model using LoRA adapters and 4-bit quantization. The model was trained on the OpenAssistant OASST1 dataset to improve instruction-following and dialogue generation capabilities while keeping hardware requirements manageable.
